description: Parse every Kubernetes resource quantity exactly and report the pairs that contradict themselves and the totals that exceed a quota. Reports a request above its own limit, which the API server accepts field by field and rejects as a pair; a memory value with a decimal SI suffix rather than the binary one; a memory value with no suffix, which is bytes; a CPU limit written with M rather than m; and requests across the set that exceed a supplied namespace quota. Pay 180000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

manifests.description: The workloads to total. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
manifests.example:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/example/web:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256M
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 512Mi
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
              value: hunter2
            - name: FEATURE_FLAG
              value: no

namespace_quota.description: The quota to compare the totals against. Omitted means no comparison, which is reported as not done rather than as a pass.

name: kubernetes_resource_coherence_audit

coherent.description: True only when every quantity parsed, no pair contradicted itself, and every comparison the caller asked for was performed.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

workloads.description: Per workload: replicas and its per-pod CPU and memory requests.

title: Kubernetes Resource Coherence Audit
